minutes_model_provider.description: Adapters implemented for explicit text-only minutes generation in the canonical UI order. The list does not imply that a connection, runtime or model is ready.

minutes_max_tokens.description: Narumi's per-request output-token limit, not a claim about model capability. The server also validates the selected parameter_schema and rejects values above a known model max_output_tokens. If omitted, the adapter uses min(4096, known model limit), or an application limit of 4096 when the model limit is unknown. Unknown model limits remain null in metadata.

reasoning_effort.description: Must be supported by the selected model's verified parameter_schema. Omission uses that model's verified default.

minutes_model_parameters.description: Closed Codex minutes generation options. max_tokens, paths, endpoints, credentials, commands and arbitrary runtime overrides are not accepted.

reasoning_effort.description: Must be advertised as supported by the selected model's verified parameter_schema. Omission uses a verified default only; unsupported effort is never silently substituted.

openai_minutes_model_parameters.description: Closed OpenAI API text minutes options. Keys unavailable on the selected model are rejected by the server; credentials and runtime overrides are never parameters.

bounded_minutes_model_parameters.description: Closed Anthropic API, OpenAI-compatible API and local Ollama text minutes options. reasoning_effort, credentials and runtime overrides are not supported.

empty_minutes_model_parameters.description: Closed Claude Agent SDK text minutes options. The verified SDK adapter accepts no model parameters, credentials, paths, commands or runtime overrides from a meeting selection.

model_id.description: Exact, explicitly selected ID from this connection's model catalog. The server validates availability and supported parameters; it never substitutes another model.

parameters.description: Closed options selected by provider below. Omit to use verified model defaults and bounded adapter defaults; no values are copied from another provider.

cache_epoch.description: Non-secret generation cache discriminator. Unchanged inputs and selection reuse the existing minutes version; incrementing this value requests a new minutes generation only.

minutes_model_selection.description: Explicit text-only minutes selection. It does not change llm_provider, transcript integration, vision, transcription or other stages. Requires an enabled, matching-revision connection with verified authentication and an available text model. Codex needs chatgpt authentication and subscription_ok or api_ok. Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI API, OpenAI-compatible API and Anthropic API need api_ok; their API-key connections also require a saved key. Ollama needs numeric loopback, a verified local model and no credentials, and may use local_only. OpenAI-compatible and Claude Agent SDK models remain unverified after metadata discovery until verify_provider_model succeeds. Unknown or unverified models are display-only and cannot be selected.

minutes_model.description: A minutes-only model override. Omitted updates retain the saved selection; null clears it. Missing in an existing saved config has the same meaning as null and preserves legacy llm_provider behavior.

provider_model_parameter.description: A scalar generation parameter supported by the adapter. Arbitrary commands, URLs, credentials or nested runtime configuration are not parameters.

provider_parameter_schema.description: Closed parameter schema for the selected model. The server must also check adapter allowlists and required names.

kind.description: Actual authentication's billing class; provider names do not determine subscription eligibility.

input_usd_per_million_tokens.description: Decimal USD value; null when not verified. Never infer zero from an unknown price.

output_usd_per_million_tokens.description: Decimal USD value; null when not verified. Never infer zero from an unknown price.

audio_usd_per_minute.description: Decimal USD value; null when not verified. Never infer zero from an unknown price.

model_id.description: Exact provider model identifier; not an automatically chosen alias.

max_output_tokens.description: Verified model capability, null when unknown. Never fill this field with Narumi's 4096-token default or 32768-token request limit. An adapter may still impose those application limits without claiming a model limit.

availability_expires_on.description: Optional availability end date supplied by the provider API, preserved as YYYY-MM-DD without inventing a time or timezone. Omission or null means no confirmed end date was supplied, not unlimited availability. Never invent an end date or use zero as a placeholder. Preserve the confirmed date with cached metadata. When the current UTC date is on or after it, the server must reject selection and generation even if cached availability was available. This is Narumi's conservative application rule, not a claim about an official shutdown time. Current-date comparison is performed by the implementation, not this schema.

provider_model_descriptor.description: Intersection of provider metadata and verified runtime/adapter support. Unknown capabilities never mean available.
